defaults.user_agent_notes: Send this app UA on every request of a source without its own headers. Never let OkHttp send its default 'okhttp/x' UA and never default to a desktop-browser UA: on 2026-10-23 Wind TV served its geo-block slate to both but real video to UAs containing ExoPlayerLib, Dalvik or an Android Chrome string. Sources that need something else carry it in their own headers (the Telemicro group needs a browser UA plus Referer; a few iptv-org entries keep the UA iptv-org lists). page_regex sources send page_headers only when fetching the page.
